regions.today: Fresh and blustery today with sunny spells and scattered showers. The showers will become isolated by the evening. Highest temperatures of 15 to 17 degrees, in moderate to fresh and gusty westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Mostly dry tonight with clear spells. Cloud will thicken by morning. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 12 degrees in mostly moderate west or southwest winds.
regions.tomorrow: Mostly cloudy tomorrow but largely dry at first. Outbreaks of rain will spread from the west later in the morning along with mist and hill fog. The rain will become patchier in the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 16 to 18 degrees in moderate to fresh and gusty southwest winds.
